subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a beneficial insect?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Termite__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Termites are small insects that live in colonies and have distinct castes and feed on wood or other dead plant matter, occurring on every continent except Antarctica. 
 
• Termites comprise the infraorder Isoptera, or alternatively the epifamily Termitidae, within the order Blattodea. 
 
• Although termites cause serious structural damage to properties, **they are not known to attack or bite people and pets** nor do they pose any serious health concerns.
 
• Termites can cause significant destruction to structures, they do not pose a direct threat to humans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Beneficial insects**__

 
 
• **​**Hoverflies.
 
• Ladybirds.
 
• Parasitic wasps.
 
• Butterflies and moths. 
 
• Lacewings.
 
• Ground beetles.
 
• Solitary bees (Hymenoptera).
